resolvedFindings.issue: Malformed errors could escape safe failure handler.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Strict dict guards for response/Error and string guards for provider/local codes before whitelist membership. Three previously failing local malformed-error cases now return safe JSON and exit1.

resolvedFindings.issue: Exclusive-create loser and concurrent readback could overwrite mutation journal.
resolvedFindings.resolution: journal_owned set only after successful exclusive apply creation; error persistence requires ownership. Readback never rewrites journal on success or failure. All three local ownership/readback probes pass.

cases: Exclusive journal loser performs no journal write
Readback failure performs no journal write
Readback success performs no journal write
Lost mutation response retains one journaled attempt, no confirmed response and rejects replay

reviewedGuards: Exact two Dev functions, fixed baseline live7/17 and fixed candidate ZIP hashes/lengths
Clean exact source HEAD/manifest hashes and release ancestry; runner SHA bound in new plan and checked at each mutation
Private plan/journal paths with exclusive initial journal and fsynced attempted-call records before mutation
Exact update_function_code bytes, PublishTrue, latest RevisionId CAS; immutable version/config/code qualification before alias
Exact live alias, unweighted candidate version and alias RevisionId CAS; latest requalified immediately before alias
Protected13-runtime snapshots, routes/schedules/cleanup/security plus role trusts/managed policy documents, resource policies, authorizers and paginated stages
Pinned SDK utility uses total_max_attempts1; no mutation retries or automatic rollback
Original immutable versions qualified as available rollback targets; no rollback executed by runner

scopeLimits: Two function changes are sequential, not an atomic cross-function transaction. An error may leave partial deployment requiring read-only state reconciliation.
Uncertain call outcomes are never replay authorization; readback does not automatically repair missing allocation/completion records.
Review establishes runner guards only; actual deployment success and post-deployment evidence require separate qualification.
No app endpoint, purchase/proof replay, secrets-value read, configuration/IAM/lifecycle change is included.
